versions.changelog:
- Initial release of agentscope-dependency-updater.
- Inspects AgentScope project dependencies by reading pyproject.toml and installed packages.
- Reports available upgrades, including compatibility notes and highlights major version changes for manual review.
- Supports custom package index URLs via the PIP_INDEX_URL environment variable.
- Outputs only non-intrusive markdown reports—no automatic changes are made to files.
- Handles offline or restricted network environments by reporting installed versions if PyPI is unreachable.
